Private Function Show(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    If IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "Null"
    Else
        Show = TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function Got(ByVal c As Range) As String
    If c Is Nothing Then
        Got = "Nothing"
    Else
        Got = c.Address(False, False)
    End If
End Function

Private Function Grid(ByVal ws As Worksheet) As String
    Dim c As Range, s As String
    For Each c In ws.Range("A1:C4")
        s = s & "|" & c.Formula
    Next
    Grid = Mid(s, 2)
End Function

Private Function Fills(ByVal ws As Worksheet) As String
    Dim c As Range, s As String
    For Each c In ws.Range("A1:C4")
        s = s & "|" & c.Interior.Color
    Next
    Fills = Mid(s, 2)
End Function

Private Function Italics(ByVal ws As Worksheet) As String
    Dim c As Range, s As String
    For Each c In ws.Range("A1:C4")
        s = s & "|" & c.Font.Italic
    Next
    Italics = Mid(s, 2)
End Function

Private Function Bolds(ByVal ws As Worksheet) As String
    Dim c As Range, s As String
    For Each c In ws.Range("A1:C4")
        s = s & "|" & c.Font.Bold
    Next
    Bolds = Mid(s, 2)
End Function
